description: This file defines the delete operation for articles in a web API, including the command, validation, and handler implementation.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete request by finding the article by slug, removing it, and saving changes to the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for the Command's Slug.

methods.name: Handle(Command, CancellationToken)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to process the delete command, delete the article, and handle errors if article not found.
